name: Jordan Ellis
summary: Recent marketing graduate with two internships in B2B sales development and campaign coordination. Skilled at outbound prospecting, email campaigns, and turning engagement data into clear next steps. Seeking an entry-level BDR or marketing coordinator role.

sections.title: Education
lines: B.S. Business Administration, Marketing, Lakeview State University, Columbus, OH, May 2026 (GPA 3.6, Dean's List)
Relevant coursework: Consumer Behavior, Digital Marketing Analytics, Professional Selling, Brand Strategy
Honors: Alpha Mu Alpha marketing honor society; Presidential Scholarship recipient (2022-2026)
Study abroad: Marketing in a Global Context, Valencia, Spain (Summer 2024)

roles.title: Sales Development Intern
bullets: Sent 60+ personalized outbound emails and calls per week to mid-market prospects, booking 18 qualified demos in 10 weeks.
Researched target accounts in HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, building a list of 250 contacts adopted by the team.
Tested two subject-line variants and raised email reply rate from 4% to 7%.
Shadowed senior account executives on 25 discovery calls and wrote concise call notes that fed the weekly pipeline review.
Built a one-page objection-handling guide from rep feedback, now part of the onboarding packet for new interns.
Presented findings on lead-source quality to the sales director at the end of the internship.
Logged all activity in HubSpot with 100% accuracy, helping managers forecast the next quarter's pipeline.

roles.title: Marketing Intern
bullets: Planned and scheduled 40+ Instagram and email posts, growing the email list by 22% in one semester.
Tracked campaign results in Google Analytics and summarized weekly findings for the owner.
Coordinated a spring loyalty promotion that lifted repeat visits by 15%.
Wrote product descriptions and newsletter copy for a seasonal menu launch, contributing to a 12% rise in online orders.
Photographed and edited content for social channels, doubling average post engagement.

roles.title: Sales Associate
bullets: Assisted 80+ customers per shift, consistently ranking in the top three for add-on sales such as accessories and bundles.
Trained five new hires on the point-of-sale system and returns process.
Helped plan the back-to-school promotion, which brought in a record week of sales for the store.
Recommended three display layouts for new inventory, one of which became the permanent front-of-store setup.

entries.title: Campus Marketing Club
entries.subtitle: Vice President of Partnerships
bullets: Secured sponsorships from 6 local businesses worth $4,500 for the annual student pitch competition.
Led a team of 8 members to run a 3-week social campaign that drew 350 attendees to the final event.
Redesigned the club's recruiting flyer and Instagram presence, growing membership from 22 to 41 students.

entries.title: Capstone: Go-to-Market Plan for a Local Fitness Startup
entries.subtitle: Team of four, graded A
bullets: Built a launch plan covering positioning, pricing, and a 90-day outreach calendar, presented to a panel of industry mentors.
Conducted 20 customer interviews and a survey of 150 local residents to size the target market.
Built a financial model projecting break-even in month 14, praised by the faculty advisor for clarity.

entries.title: Volunteer Fundraising Lead, Community Food Pantry
entries.subtitle: Student volunteer program
bullets: Wrote outreach emails to 120 local businesses and raised $3,200 for the winter food drive.
Tracked donors and follow-ups in a shared spreadsheet, achieving a 35% repeat-donor rate.
Organized two volunteer drive days with 30 participants each.
